name: Islamic Society of Greater Houston
mission: To provide religious and social services to all Muslims and to provide channels of understanding and communication between Muslims and the Houston community in general.
theoryOfChange: Our goal is to serve the needs of our community by specializing in services that are essential to its success. From educating our youth to serving the under privileged, ISGH offers an array of services that cater to most segments of our community.
scoreSummary: Islamic Society of Greater Houston shows strong alignment and moderate impact, with zakat compliance.
zakatClaimEvidence: The Islamic Society of Greater Houston (ISGH) explicitly states, "Give your Zakat locally with the Islamic Society of Greater Houston and help support 970+ families every month with rent, utilities, and other needs." They also offer "Zakat-Ul-Maal" as a donation option and have a dedicated email address for zakat: "zakat@isgh.org". Furthermore, ISGH reported distributing over $4.9M in Zakat and Sadaqah in 2024, supporting over 890 families monthly with food, rent, utilities, education, and transportation costs. (Source: https://www.facebook.com/ISGH.ORG/videos/give-your-zakat-locally-with-isgh/411540471496127/)

rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Society of Greater Houston (ISGH) provides essential social and religious services to help community members live sustainable lives. <cite id="3">Founded in 1969</cite>, the organization has established a long track record of serving the local Muslim population in Texas. Its community-based operations include <cite id="2">Assistance Services, Marriage Services, Clinics, Funeral Services, and Islamic Schools</cite>. ISGH operates five full-time accredited Islamic schools through its subsidiary, the Islamic Education Institute of Texas. The organization accepts zakat to support local individuals in need.
